notes.title: Dev Diaries: Graphics Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Adventurers, we continue our journey into upgrading the graphical elements of our environment, moving away from generic and low-poly assets.[/h3]

To give you the full picture, let’s start from the beginning. As we said, we purchased ready-made assets. We acquired various materials to test our ideas. At this stage, we created gray prototypes based on concepts and experimented with low-poly models with simple textures. This was essential to quicken the game’s development. Now, let’s share what came out of this process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/6bb9dafe91da1ab300d304728d9adfee7abfca7d.png[/img]

Right from the start, after purchasing the ready-made assets, we faced the need for significant adjustments in materials, scales, and styles of the assets themselves. This led to our first experiments in creating locations and visual effects, which allowed us to quickly do a playable island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/57cda222985480a2ff0633080ba22d0f3b507185.png[/img]

While our work on locations progressed successfully, we encountered challenges with character models due to our inexperience with low-poly modeling. The process of creating characters requested time and effort, especially when attempting to adjust stylized concepts into 3D. Turned out, making characters look like actual characters and not geometric nightmares is harder than it sounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/7883d0d826826a2d69a44c77a8534404783c860e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/8649c91e3a227cb60946b73bf58af1c378ea948d.png[/img]

We realized that working with low-poly models did not achieve the desired effect. This raised the question: why stick to a style that fails to impress if switching to high-poly models can improve visual quality without genuinely extending development time? Therefore, we decided to complicate our character models by adding more polygons and abandoning low-poly stylization, while still maintaining our 3D art style. Surprisingly, this step allowed us to speed up the art production process and improve the game’s visual quality. It’s important to note that we are not abandoning ready-made assets and will use them as sketches for further refinement.

Well, how about this transformation from pig to warg? And you wouldn’t recognize Farro anymore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/a1dace2326915f9731618e54362601003388f9fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/530f042a8d51f8387f050c2850b1b65792c6b262.png[/img]

Recently, we have made significant strides in content development, creating new character models, armor, weapons, and upgrading environments and visual effects. Our journey in evolving our art process and optimization continues, and we are confident in the direction we’ve chosen. Not one step back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/fad8e64eefa8d57ec15fe0bf9f827f68f2e861db.png[/img]

However, there’s still much to be done: from location update and creating new islands to improving animations and working on finer details. Our mission? To take the WorldShards game world to the next level!

[b]Stay tuned for the next Dev Diaries![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/5c262e88e4e14fb8800cb7fca3ded3937a2cbc97.gif[/img]

notes.title: WorldShards DevBlog - Graphics Update
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

It’s been a while since our last update on WorldShard’s development journey, so we decided to show the highlights of what we’ve been working on so far. Hope you’ll enjoy this paw-tasic dive into WorldShards!

This spring we put together [b]the first playable build[/b], showcased it at the MEFCC, GDC, & Unity Developer Day, allowing us to gather lots of valuable feedback and impressions. Though this version of the game is not public (stay tuned — when the time comes, we’ll let you know about the public demo and its dates), the work on the next version is in full swing. Right now however, we want to show you the ways in which WorldShards has already transformed.

One of the most important visual aspects in any game is the main character. After all, the environment changes while you wander around the game's world, but your character is constantly there, a focal point on your screen.

If you’ve seen some of our earlier snapshots, you may have noticed that we used a low-poly approach for the models. However, we never intended to have this in the final version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/0be4d4e090c5cd2067e70fff98244ddbce228a80.jpg[/img]
[i]Looking back at the models - how they used to look and the way they are now! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/c8e7140f546dcd747cfa9a7cba72434b6209ab7a.jpg[/img]

So, what do we want WorldShards to look like? We find a special charm in [b]the low-poly visuals[/b], so we’re not going to fully abandon it, but we’ll be giving the game [b]an extra layer of detail[/b] making it look a lot more high-definition. 

Check out this comparison to see what we mean!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/906648dbe78c0a084e9fcd29e1af1d2585bf8273.jpg[/img]

This is just a glimpse of the many improvements we've made. But have you ever wondered how these changes look from our side? Let us show you the creation process of two 3D models – the Warg and one of our crafting stations. Seeing each step of the iterative process and the evolution is clear as day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/544c7fda207e6e831304bfa51f50d8e5a5ad0e0e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/0d53e0afb086841d06f7269d466e4b6bc2173148.jpg[/img]
[i]By the way, can you guess what this crafting station is used for?[/i]

So, what graphical improvements are we currently working on?
[list]
[*] Environment (from the lighting to the flower textures)
[*] Models (player, enemies, animals) and animations (movement, idles, attacks, etc.)
[*] VFX (spells, abilities, environmental, etc.)
[/list]

And as a parting gift, we want to give you one last teaser. Besides graphical improvements, we've been working on a bunch of [b]new features[/b] for WorldShards. For example, crafting equipment and building player housing. We're really excited about these features and can't wait to share more with you!
You can keep up to date by [url=https://twitter.com/WorldShardsGame]following us on Twitter[/url] or [url=discord.gg/pyfCtJc93c]joining our Discord server[/url] for more news and [b]daily updates[/b]!
